name: agent-index-marketplace
description: Discover, download, and install collections from the agent-index marketplace. Manage your org’s installed collections and keep them up to date. v2.15.0 (Release C.1.3.4 — admin-upstream source-of-truth): check-updates 2.11.0 — for a self-distributing org the admin-upstream 'is the org current?' check is a git check in the admin's local clones (git fetch --tags), never a WebSearch or the member-facing public directory (which is by design behind the org's internal versions); a web-searched stale snapshot caused 'nothing to update' while the org was ahead (adminupstreamstale). Constraint added forbidding WebSearch for version/release/directory discovery. Pairs with core 3.22.4. v2.14.0 (Release C.1.3 — dist SHA gate): check-updates 2.10.0 now ACTUALLY computes + verifies the SHA-256 of each /shared/dist/ artifact against the manifest (the canonical stored-bytes hash, not aifs_read stdout) and escalates a mismatch to a top-of-report BLOCKER — pre-C.1.3 it read the manifest for versions but never hashed the artifacts, so the integrity property the backend-distribution model promises did not exist (shagateunimplemented). Pairs with core 3.22.0 (publish-updates republishes /shared/dist/; apply-updates verifies it). v2.13.0 (Release C — backend distribution): check-updates 2.9.0 reads the org's 'latest' from /shared/dist/manifest.json on the org backend (not GitHub) — member-current = vs the manifest, org-vs-upstream = an admin git check; this dissolves the listinglag/shasolve stale-version-check class. download-collection 2.3.0 sources a collection from the admin's tag-pinned local clone (via the clone-script-generator), not a zip_url download, and republishes /shared/dist/. Members never fetch from github.com (standards.md § Distribution: backend-first; GitHub demoted to admin/deprecated). v2.12.0 (Release B): install-collection setupresp guardrail — Step 1 (write collection-setup-responses.md with setup_status: complete) is mandatory and is NOT skipped by an 'accept defaults' shortcut; a defaults install writes the responses file (empty-but-complete when there are no org params), verified by read-back before marking installed. Closes the org-wide member block where a bulk/defaults install left collections with no responses file (bug 20260615-8d20ea22-setupresp). v2.9.1: upgrade-collection 1.1.0 adds Step 6.5 provisioning detection — if the target version adds/changes collaborative-acls.json or setup/collection-setup.md, the upgrade plan and the closing summary flag PROVISIONING REQUIRED and route the admin to @ai:install-collection (idempotent) to apply grants and re-run the setup interview; the upgrade is not presented as complete until then. Encodes post-release finding F1 from the strategy 1.1.0 upgrade (file sync succeeded, share-strategy broken org-wide because the index folder + all@ grant were never provisioned). v2.9.0: check-updates 2.6.0 + refresh-marketplace-cache 2.3.0 append a cache-buster query param to every raw.githubusercontent.com directory/version fetch — the fetch layer caches by exact URL and otherwise serves stale directories, silently hiding fresh releases (check-updates would report 'up to date' against pre-release bytes). Closes bug 20260601-8d20ea22-2. v2.8.0: install-collection 2.0.0 → 2.1.0 adds Step 5.5 — provisions a collection's declared collaborative-folder ACLs (collaborative-acls.json) via the permission-change-helper skill at install time, so collections whose members must write shared state (e.g. bug-reports' bugs/) get the required all@ writer grant under the least-privilege access model. Supports bug 20260531-8d20ea22. v2.5.0: check-updates 2.4.0 gains contract-version-aware surfacing — adapter contract gaps that block installed collections are escalated to a top-of-report BLOCKER naming the driving collections; gaps without consequence remain a passive opportunity NOTE. Collections may declare requires_contract_version in collection.json; check-updates computes max across installed collections and compares against the local adapter’s contract_version. Lightweight-mode result gains contract_blockers[]. Closes idea contract-version-aware-update-surfacing. v2.4.0: check-updates gains an Available-to-Install section — surfaces capabilities present in installed collections that the running member hasn't picked up yet, mirroring org-setup's management-dashboard signal. v2.3.0: new `@ai:upgrade-collection` task closes bug 20260502-8d20ea22 — admins can now upgrade an already-installed marketplace collection in one verb (counterpart to `@ai:publish-updates --check-upstream` for infrastructure and `@ai:edit-org → Update Adapter Bundle` for filesystem adapters). Setup-responses preserved during upgrade. CHANGELOG entry written for member-side @ai:apply-updates consumption. v2.2.x: check-updates 'what to do' guidance + Step 2.6 binary surfacing. v2.1.x: extended adapter contract surfacing.
